hero.subtitle: People work alone in studios and on stages across Gyeonggi. It is hard to keep that up alone, so we gathered to back each other.

mission.heading: Our Purpose
mission.p1: Artists working in Gyeonggi came together and set up a producer cooperative. The registered name is Gyeonggi Art Collective Cooperative. Making work is mostly done alone and the income is not steady. We built this to handle those conditions together instead of each on our own.
mission.p2: The cooperative exists to support artists in Gyeonggi. Keeping creative work from stalling partway, and being of use to the local arts ecosystem, are part of that purpose. The first task is education, training, and information for members' rights and interests.
mission.p3: Our operations are music production and distribution, performance planning and management, and arts education. The point is that what members make gets its fair value and reaches an audience. When the work pays, the work continues.
mission.p4: We work across all of Gyeonggi-do. We run arts education programs for local residents and students. We also work with other cooperatives and regional institutions. Members are creators, organizers, and supporting members. Anyone who agrees with what the cooperative is for can join.
mission.p5: What the cooperative wants is for artists' rights to be respected and for what comes of the work to be shared with the region. We are looking for people to do it with.

chairman.heading: A Message from the President
chairman.name: President Choi Hee-cheol
chairman.quote1: To my fellow artists. Hello, I am Choi Hee-cheol, President of the Gyeonggi Art Collective Cooperative. I understand, perhaps more than anyone, the sense of helplessness that comes with the word 'alone.' I believe our coming together will carve a warm path through that helplessness.
chairman.quote2: Here, not only your successes but also your failures and struggles become precious assets. Please don't hesitate to share your voice. We are always ready to listen.
